title: EgoMonth: A Month-Level Egocentric Video Benchmark for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.13113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have led to substantial progress in video understanding, accompanied by a growing number of long video benchmarks. However, existing benchmarks rely predominantly on web-sourced videos that lack inter-clip spatiotemporal continuity, making it difficult to assess whether models can maintain consistent memory across days or weeks of real-world experience. We introduce EgoMonth, the first month-level egocentric video understanding benchmark. EgoMonth comprises over 300 hours of first-person daily-life recordings from 20 participants spanning 20 to 120 days, paired with 1,443 human-crafted multiple-choice question-answer pairs. We design a cognitively grounded 14-task evaluation framework organized into three hierarchical cognitive levels: Schema Consolidation, Episodic Indexing, and Cascading Reasoning. translated_title: EgoMonth：面向长期时空记忆的月级别自我中心视频基准
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的进步推动了视频理解领域的显著发展，同时伴随着越来越多的长视频基准测试的出现。然而，现有基准主要依赖于网络来源的视频，这些视频缺乏片段间的时空连续性，难以评估模型是否能在数天或数周的真实世界体验中保持一致的记忆。我们引入了EgoMonth，这是首个月级别的自我中心视频理解基准。EgoMonth包含来自20名参与者、跨越20至120天的超过300小时第一人称日常生活录像，并配有1,443对人工构建的多选题问答对。我们设计了一个基于认知的14任务评估框架，该框架分为三个层次化的认知级别：图式整合、情景索引和级联推理。对最先进的开源和闭源MLLMs的评估揭示了它们的局限性。
tldr: 本文提出了首个月级别自我中心视频基准EgoMonth，通过300多小时真实生活录像和三级认知任务框架，揭示了现有MLLMs在长期时空记忆上的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EgoMonth, the first month-level egocentric video benchmark with over 300 hours of real-life footage and a three-level cognitive task framework, exposing limitations of current MLLMs in long-term spatiotemporal memory.
